Against an 80s laser-studio backdrop with a tipping column and fern, seven mismatched robots wear the same ugly argyle vests: a stiff proud dad caught mid-blink with a forced grin, his hand floating over mom's shoulder and patting grandpa; an exhausted mom leaning into dad while hoisting a cross-eyed, plug-pacifier baby between them and gripping the kid's shoulder; an eye-rolling teen in headphones set apart with crossed arms and a tapping foot; a rusty grandpa asleep front-centre on a stool, beard drooping and sleep-bubbles rising; a feral kid on a crate waving both arms, propeller spinning, one foot kicking toward grandpa; and a dog-bot scratching its ear and looking up at the teen. Tangled charging cables loop around their feet, tying the whole reluctant family together.
